An '''earsculpt''' was a small [[Ea/Legends|ear]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] used by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] operative [[Selby Jarrad]] during the liberation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Verkuyl]]. The device was smoothly curved and flexible, with a tiny speaker that fit into the wearers' [[Ear/Legends|ear]].
